description: Change title, description or scheme; set a ref once on a dashboard that has none. Send only the fields to change. A ref can be set once, on a dashboard that has none. Needs an API key: with none yet, call signup first.

indexable.description: False takes the public page out of search engines, the gallery and the sitemap and mints a claim token (claimToken on the dashboard) for the person it was built for; true puts it back and drops the token. A dashboard already out keeps its token.

isShowcase.description: True lists a published dashboard in the gallery, where search engines may index it (409 not_public on a dashboard that is not published); false takes it out, leaving the page to people with the link. Unpublishing clears it.

ref.description: A slug you choose, 1 to 64 of a-z, 0-9 and -. Unique per owner for dashboards and per dashboard for visuals, and set once. Create with a ref so a later run finds the same object instead of making a duplicate.

name: update_dashboard
title: Update dashboard
